name: main
sql: SELECT sum(CostUsd) AS cost, sum(InputTokens + OutputTokens) AS total_tokens, sumIf(CostUsd, StartedAt >= subtractDays(now(), 7)) AS week_cost, sumIf(CostUsd, StartedAt >= subtractDays(now(), 14) AND StartedAt < subtractDays(now(), 7)) AS prior_week_cost, sum(RateLimited) AS rate_limited FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
